description: MTA Daily Ridership and Traffic: Beginning 2020 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The daily ridership dataset provides systemwide ridership and traffic estimates for subways (including the Staten Island Railway), buses, Long Island Rail Road, Metro-North Railroad, Access-A-Ride, Bridges and Tunnels, and the Central Business District and Congestion Relief Zone since the start of Congestion Pricing. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are bus, passengers, cbdtp, central business district, central business district tolling program. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Transportation Authority. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
